hero.sub: Konihaus installs and manages your Smart Home — platform-agnostic, local, without vendor lock-in. For seniors, renters, and vacation home owners in Switzerland.

intro.p1: Most smart home solutions lock you into a proprietary ecosystem: Google, Amazon, or Apple. Konihaus does it differently.
intro.p2: I use devices you already own, and add proven hardware from leading manufacturers — Konihaus doesn't manufacture any devices itself. Everything comes together through Greenhub, your home's hub.
intro.p3: The value isn't in an app you have to operate — it's in automations that simply work: irrigation, shades, lighting and heating adjust themselves, without you having to do anything.
intro.link: Let me show you some examples
intro.card1_b: Your data is processed locally, remote access for support is encrypted, and notifications are optional and may go through external services like Apple or Google.
intro.card2_b: The devices blend in quietly — you barely notice them day to day. For elderly relatives, for example: if the kitchen sees no movement for a whole day while the person is home, the system automatically notifies family or caregivers — otherwise, daily life just stays daily life.
intro.card3_b: Irrigation, shades, lights, heating — they work on their own. No app required day to day.

faq.sub: Quote, contract and hardware — the key points, briefly explained.
faq.q1: How long am I committed for?
faq.a1: If you replace the setup investment with a 2-year service agreement, the minimum term is 24 months. After that the contract continues indefinitely and either side can cancel with one month's notice, effective at the end of a month. If you pay the setup cost upfront, there is no minimum term.
faq.q2: How do I cancel, and what happens if I cancel early?
faq.a2: Cancel in writing or by email, with one month's notice effective at the end of a month. If you end the contract before the minimum term expires, you can either pay the waived setup investment pro rata and keep the hardware, or return the hardware within 14 days — in which case no payment is due.
faq.a3: Yes — once you've paid the setup investment in full, either upfront or through the 2-year service agreement. Until then it remains Konihaus's property, but stays installed and in use at your home.
faq.q4: What happens if a device fails or I want to swap it?
faq.a4: I handle manufacturer warranty claims for you — you never have to deal with the manufacturer yourself. Most devices, like sensors or plugs, you can swap yourself with my remote guidance; if a replacement needs professional installation on site, we schedule a visit for that. Any cost for that visit is quoted to you in advance — nothing is billed without your prior approval. Because we build on open standards (Zigbee, Z-Wave, Matter, WiFi), you can swap or add individual devices at any time without rebuilding the system.
faq.q5: What keeps working after the contract ends?
faq.a5: Remote access, support and updates from us stop when the contract ends. Your locally installed system — the Home Assistant hub and all devices — keeps running on its own as long as it belongs to you. On request, you'll get the access credentials and configuration documentation.
faq.a6: Any time — upgrading is very welcome. For every request I put together a new quote: a small addition is billed once, moving to a higher package raises the monthly fee. Existing equipment is almost always reused; only a bigger leap needs a new hub, and even then you only pay the difference. Costs depend on the scope — the current packages show the range. A new minimum term only applies for bigger changes like a new hub, not for adding a few devices.
faq.q7: How does the quotation process work?
faq.a7: After your request, I get in touch with you personally. We first talk through your situation and what you'd like. Then I visit you, look at everything on site and measure what a good solution needs. I explain the options and, where it makes sense, show you several scenarios, for example a leaner one and a more comprehensive one. Only after that do you receive the written quote. It lists every cost individually, meaning devices, setup and monthly management, and shows what is waived with a 2-year service agreement. So you know exactly what you're paying for before you decide.

beispiel_luca.title: Luca — the barbershop in Affoltern
beispiel_luca.subtitle: An example of how Konihaus could take the daily small stuff off a small barbershop — from opening up to locking up.
beispiel_luca.hero_tag:
More time at the chair.
Less small stuff.
beispiel_luca.sit_body: Luca, 29, runs a small barbershop in Affoltern am Albis — as a tenant. Together with his colleague Marco he works two chairs, and a third seat could be ready quickly if needed. Appointments come in through a booking app, with walk-ins in between. Whoever is at the chair has no free hand: unlocking, lights, music, towels, ventilating, locking up — it all happens on the side.
beispiel_luca.worry1: What if somebody left the steamer or the towel warmer on again tonight?
beispiel_luca.worry2: What if walk-ins see “Closed” even though a chair is free?
beispiel_luca.worry3: Steam, hairspray and chemicals make the air heavy — and in the middle of a busy day nobody thinks of ventilating.
beispiel_luca.worry4: The door stands open all day, the warmth escapes and the heating bill climbs.
beispiel_luca.worry5: At night the shop stands empty behind a shop window. The cleaner and suppliers need access, and keys get passed from hand to hand.
beispiel_luca.worry6: Luca doesn't know when it is really busiest — and in the middle of a haircut he can't look at his phone.
beispiel_luca.sol_title: The solution: a salon that thinks along
beispiel_luca.sol_intro: For Luca, our All-in package would be a good fit, from CHF 149 per month, with around 25 devices. Everything is stuck on, plugged in or mounted reversibly — no drilling.
beispiel_luca.out_title: What this could mean for the salon
beispiel_luca.out_luca1: One message in the evening instead of ten walk-rounds: everything off, everything locked.
beispiel_luca.out_luca2: The weekly report shows when it's really busy — useful for planning appointments and walk-ins.
beispiel_luca.out_luca3: Water, smoke and break-in alerts go straight to his phone.
beispiel_luca.out_team1: Fewer tasks between two customers — lights, music and towel warmer follow the day.
beispiel_luca.out_team2: One button to open, one to close — no app required.
beispiel_luca.out_team3: Devices and rooms are recorded, not people: no cameras, no tracking of the team.
beispiel_luca.out_kund1: A warm towel, the right lighting and fresh air.
beispiel_luca.out_kund2: Walk-ins can see right away whether a chair is free.
beispiel_luca.out_kund3: No cameras at the chairs — the salon stays private.
beispiel_luca.cost_note: Hardware one-off ~CHF 700–900 · around 25 devices, no drilling

beispiel_luca.cta_b: Take a closer look at the “All in” package, or book a free, no-obligation consultation.
beispiel_luca.sol1_b: 15 minutes before the first appointment, lights, mirror LEDs, music, coffee machine and sign switch on by themselves.
beispiel_luca.sol2_b: The warmer pre-heats shortly before the next appointment and switches off after the last one.
beispiel_luca.sol3_t: Closing scene at the press of a button
beispiel_luca.sol3_b: A button by the exit switches everything off and the door sensors confirm “locked” — Luca gets a single message. Cleaning reminders run on a small tablet.
beispiel_luca.sol4_b: Power monitoring on the steamer, dryer strip and charging station reports if anything is still drawing power 20 minutes after closing.
beispiel_luca.sol5_b: Presence sensors at the chairs (no cameras) show at the door whether a seat is free. The third chair is already prepared.
beispiel_luca.sol6_b: Welcome light when someone walks in, calm morning light, a warmer afternoon scene, a weekend setup — by wall button, no app needed.
beispiel_luca.sol7_b: Leak sensors under both basins and at the hot water tank, plus a smart smoke and heat detector.
beispiel_luca.sol8_b: A CO₂, humidity and temperature sensor prompts ventilation, or starts it, when steam and hairspray make the air heavy.
beispiel_luca.sol9_b: Front door, back door and shop-window sensors, a motion detector and a siren alert your phone if something isn't right at night.
beispiel_luca.sol10_b: The cleaner gets a code for Tuesdays 06:00–07:00, suppliers a single time window. No more keys passed around. Installed in agreement with the landlord.
beispiel_luca.sol11_b: The door sensor counts visits — without a camera. A weekly report shows peak hours and quiet windows.

beispiel_peter.title: Peter & Helene — 6-month world trip
beispiel_peter.subtitle: An example of how Konihaus could keep an eye on a house during a long journey.
beispiel_peter.hero_tag:
Your home in good hands.
Wherever you are.
beispiel_peter.sit_body: Peter, 64, and Helene, 65, have just retired and own a three-storey single-family house in Zurich. From April to September they are planning a trip around the world — the house will stand empty for six months. It has electric blinds, dimmable LED lighting and an alarm system about 20 years old that isn't connected to anything. Both are tech-savvy and want as much security as possible while they're away.
beispiel_peter.worry1: What if a slow leak goes unnoticed for two weeks? Water damage can get very expensive very quickly.
beispiel_peter.worry2: What if something goes wrong with the older heat pump, the EV charger or the electrical installation — and nobody notices?
beispiel_peter.worry3: What if the empty house becomes a target for burglars and the locks can't be checked remotely?
beispiel_peter.worry4: What if humidity or heat quietly damage the empty house?
beispiel_peter.worry5: What if something happens while they're in Southeast Asia — and they can't fly back within 24 hours?
beispiel_peter.worry6: What if the insurance no longer covers everything after a longer vacancy?
beispiel_peter.sol_title: The solution: your home in view, worldwide
beispiel_peter.sol_intro: For Peter and Helene, our most comprehensive holiday-home package would be a good fit: a one-off hardware investment of around CHF 3,630 and CHF 189 per month.
beispiel_peter.sol1_b: Eight sensors in the kitchen, bathrooms, laundry room, boiler room and cellar report a leak immediately.
beispiel_peter.sol2_b: Smart circuit monitoring spots faults and anomalies early.
beispiel_peter.sol3_b: Four sensors keep temperature and humidity in check — against mould, frost and heat damage.
beispiel_peter.sol4_b: Six sensors confirm that everything is closed. The smart lock can be checked remotely and gives service providers temporary access.
beispiel_peter.sol5_b: If the Wi-Fi goes down, the house stays reachable over mobile data — even while travelling abroad.
beispiel_peter.sol6_b: Random lighting and blind patterns make the house look lived in. You control heating and locks conveniently via the app.
beispiel_peter.out_title: What this could mean for the two of them
beispiel_peter.out_peter1: Gets a notification on his phone straight away if a water sensor triggers.
beispiel_peter.out_peter2: Can adjust the thermostat while travelling, if needed.
beispiel_peter.out_peter3: Less constant checking in with neighbours and family.
beispiel_peter.out_helene1: More confidence in the safety of the house during the six months.
beispiel_peter.out_helene2: A daily “all is well” email and a weekly report show climate and water consumption.
beispiel_peter.out_helene3: Timestamped logs can help with the insurer — discounts are possible, but worth asking your own insurer about.
beispiel_peter.out_reise1: Enjoy Nepal, Thailand and Peru — without daily worries about the house.
beispiel_peter.out_reise2: Come back to a house that has been looked after in the meantime.
beispiel_peter.out_reise3: A single prevented water-damage incident can outweigh the system costs many times over.
beispiel_peter.cost_note: Hardware, installation and onboarding one-off ~CHF 3,630 · 6 months in total ~CHF 4,764

beispiel_elsa.subtitle: An illustration of how Konihaus could help a renter in Bern catch a leak early — instead of the next morning.
beispiel_elsa.disclaimer: This story is an illustrative example, not a documented customer account. The name and details are invented.
beispiel_elsa.hero_tag:
Leak detected in seconds.
